
```
./bench_smallbatch --model=/models/llama-q4f16 --seq=16 --batch=8 --warmup=5 --runs=100 --out=profile.json
```
kai: starting that now on a repro node with same driver. I'll capture perf and nvprof flamegraph. give me ~25m.

kai: reproduced locally; flamegraph shows unexpected spin in scheduler::yield at high concurrency. uploading flame: https://artifacts.redwood/flame/ci-nightly-20260315-03/fg.svg
maria: good find. next steps: aj to run bisect + rollback candidate, kai to prepare small patch to avoid spin, nora to prepare rollback PR if bisect confirms.
nora: noted, prepping rollback PR in case. tagging infra-sre for rollout hold: @infra-sre
aj: bisect started (job id bisect-5678). will post results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: thanks team. if anyone gets a quick mitigation (config to reduce concurrency) drop it here and we'll canary.
kai: temp mitigation: set MAX_WORKERS=4 in runtime config — reduces p95 to ~138ms in local test.
aj: pushed config canary to staging, monitoring.
maria: ack — will watch the canary through the night. :eyes: 
bench-bot: alert acknowledged, automated rollback not triggered (policy=manual).
